title: DOW-UAP-D091, Range Fouler Debrief, Atlantic Ocean, 2020
doc_notes: This document is a U.S. Navy Range Fouler Debrief form describing an unidentified aerial phenomenon encounter in the Atlantic Ocean, featuring redactions of specific identifying information.

incidents.summary: U.S. military operator observed a dark, maroonish, balloon-shaped object in controlled airspace.
behavior: did not maneuver or change direction
incidents.quote: The object itself was a darker , maroonish color, approximately 12-lSft in height
